name: Quiet Swan 35
author: TimTrayler
description: Dark rounded green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #313033 to #84da89, background-color changes from #313033 to #3a4b39, transform becomes translateX(1.9em). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #3a4b39.
